Position: Elementary Teacher (Grades K-5)

The Elementary Teacher plans and delivers instruction aligned to state standards and supports the academic and social growth of every student.

Essential Duties

  • Develop and deliver daily lesson plans aligned with Texas Essential Knowledge and Skills (TEKS).
  • Use data from assessments to differentiate instruction.
  • Maintain effective classroom management and a positive learning environment.
  • Communicate regularly with parents and guardians about student progress.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university
  • Valid Texas teaching certificate (EC-6 Core Subjects or Generalist EC-6)
  • Two (2) years of classroom teaching experience preferred
  • Experience with differentiated instruction and classroom management
  • Proficiency with Google Classroom or similar learning management systems

Working Conditions

  • Must pass a criminal background check and fingerprinting.
  • Able to lift up to 25 pounds.
